concepts.label: couchbase-cli setting-xdcr
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - follows the tool:couchbase-cli-<subcommand> naming convention; sets GLOBAL default settings for all XDCR replications on a cluster, as against tool:couchbase-cli-xdcr-replicate's --settings flag which sets settings for one replication

concepts.label: XDCR Advanced Settings
concepts.reused_or_minted: reused - the checkpoint-interval/worker-batch-size/doc-batch-size/nozzle/bandwidth/compression/optimistic-replication-threshold option group, here applied cluster-wide as defaults rather than per-replication

relations.subject: tool:couchbase-cli-setting-xdcr
relations.evidence: This command sets global default settings for all XDCR replications.

relations.subject: tool:couchbase-cli-xdcr-replicate
relations.object: changing settings for a single XDCR replication rather than the global default
relations.evidence: If you only want to change the settings for a single XDCR replication see the [xdcr-replicate](couchbase-cli-xdcr-replicate.md) command.

relations.subject: xdcr:advanced-settings
relations.object: max-processes not documented with a stated default
relations.evidence:
\--max-processes <num>

Specify the number of processes allocated to XDCR.

notable_absence.finding: This subcommand changes GLOBAL defaults for every XDCR replication on a cluster - arguably the highest-blast-radius XDCR CLI action in this batch - yet, like its siblings, states no RBAC role requirement anywhere on the page. Also notably absent: --max-processes has no stated valid range or default, unlike every sibling numeric flag on this same page (checkpoint-interval: 60-14,400; worker-batch-size: 500-10,000; doc-batch-size: 10-100,000; failure-restart-interval: 1-300; nozzle counts: 1-10) - a flag-description asymmetry consistent with the round's flag-description-copy-paste-across-siblings watch item, except here it is a gap rather than a false copy: --max-processes was evidently added later or by a different author and never got the same range treatment as its neighbours.

cross_component_finding: setting-xdcr's option list is near-identical to xdcr-replicate's per-replication --settings option list (same flag names: checkpoint-interval, worker-batch-size, doc-batch-size, failure-restart-interval, source/target-nozzle-per-node, bandwidth-usage-limit, enable-compression, stats-interval, optimistic-replication-threshold, log-level), confirming these are genuinely the same xdcr:advanced-settings group exposed at two scopes (global default vs per-replication override) rather than two different settings groups that happen to share names - the page explicitly cross-references this scope distinction rather than leaving it implicit.
